body: Fixed and pushed through normal signed commit hooks. The decoder now rejects v7 without an introduction-only branch and v6 without current merge support. A valid v7 still needs no supported merge when its own introduction-only branch justifies that layout; existing v4 compatibility and v5 evidence validation are preserved. The new regression retags an actual checked v5 schema refutation as v6 and v7 and requires rejection. It failed before the fix and passes afterward. The affected library passed 811 tests (one existing report-only test ignored), strict all-target entailment Clippy passed, and all 13 public proof tests passed on scalar WASM/Node. Fresh hosted CI remains required for merge.
